question: Which attention11 and attention15 heads supply the small auxiliary conversion left after attention9 is clamped under MLP8-complement actuation?

authority.finding: Attention9+11+15 jointly accounts for 95.4/97.1% behavior and 95.5/96.0% Q8 norm. The MLP9-15 and late-MLP banks have only 1.6-2.1% and -0.5 to -1.0% conditional behavioral marginals.

frozen_design.population: The same 29 jointly capable fresh-v6 A1/A2 rows and frozen MLP8 post-cue complement.
frozen_design.conditioning: Every arm clamps the complete attention9 pre-c_proj response to native base. A head arm additionally clamps one pre-c_proj head slice in attention11 or attention15. Full-layer and all-auxiliary arms verify exact coverage.
frozen_design.inventory: All nine heads in attention11 and all nine heads in attention15; no head selection, fitting, or rank search.
frozen_design.metric: Each head's conditional marginal beyond attention9, normalized both to the full auxiliary marginal and to the live MLP8-complement route.

predictions.pred_a_authority_replay_self_clamp_finit: Hashes, parent core/core+aux replay, self-clamp, complete-head coverage, finite metrics, and price pass.
predictions.pred_b_at_least_one_stable_material_auxi: At least one head carries at least 10% of full auxiliary behavior and Q8 norm in both panels.
predictions.pred_c_all_auxiliary_heads_replay_group_: Clamping all attention11/15 heads in addition to attention9 replays the registered core+auxiliary group within .001 on behavior and Q8 fractions.
predictions.pred_d_top_auxiliary_head_is_directional: The top stable head has behavior and Q8 cosine at least .85 to the full auxiliary marginal in both panels.
predictions.pred_e_zero_fit_complete_head_inventory: All 18 heads, both full layers, their union, and core reference are evaluated with no fit or model update.

decision: Screen freezes stable heads for a prospective union confirmation and weight compilation. If distributed, use a greedy conditional union selected on one panel and confirmed on the other; do not sum singleton marginals.
